m: Chips: oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt, roast 35 to 40 minutes.
Caramelised onions: slice the onions thin and cook low in oil with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden. Add the sugar and vinegar for the last 2 minutes.
Bash the steaks to about 1cm thick and season well.
Sear in a smoking hot pan, 1 to 2 minutes a side. Rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Split and toast the Turkish rolls. Melt a cheese slice on the steak in the pan.
Build: mayo, lettuce, sliced tomato, steak and cheese, plenty of onions. Serve with chips.
l: Steak and onions over salad, or in a wrap. Keep the bread separate so it doesn't go soggy.
g: GF buns instead of Turkish rolls, toasted separately.
